cc_people.insert: r.issuer=$1 AND r.subject=$2 AND $3 IS NULL

cc_previews.insert: r.seeker_issuer=$1 AND r.seeker_subject=$2 AND r.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND r.coach_person_id<>r.seeker_person_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_coach_codes c WHERE c.coach_person_id=r.coach_person_id AND c.coach_issuer=r.coach_issuer AND c.coach_subject=r.coach_subject)

cc_links.read: (r.seeker_issuer=$1 AND r.seeker_subject=$2 AND r.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id') OR (r.coach_issuer=$1 AND r.coach_subject=$2 AND r.coach_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND r.state='active' AND r.expires_at > now() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_people p WHERE p.person_id=r.seeker_person_id AND p.issuer=r.seeker_issuer AND p.subject=r.seeker_subject) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_link_drops d WHERE d.link_id=r.link_id))
cc_links.insert: r.seeker_issuer=$1 AND r.seeker_subject=$2 AND r.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND r.coach_person_id<>r.seeker_person_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_previews v WHERE v.link_id=r.link_id AND v.seeker_person_id=r.seeker_person_id AND v.coach_person_id=r.coach_person_id AND v.coach_issuer=r.coach_issuer AND v.coach_subject=r.coach_subject AND v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id)

cc_snapshots.read: (r.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_links l WHERE l.link_id=r.link_id AND l.seeker_person_id=r.seeker_person_id AND l.seeker_issuer=$1 AND l.seeker_subject=$2)) OR (r.coach_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_link_drops d WHERE d.link_id=r.link_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_links l WHERE l.link_id=r.link_id AND l.coach_person_id=r.coach_person_id AND l.coach_issuer=$1 AND l.coach_subject=$2 AND l.state='active' AND l.revision=r.revision AND l.expires_at > now() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_people p WHERE p.person_id=l.seeker_person_id AND p.issuer=l.seeker_issuer AND p.subject=l.seeker_subject)))
cc_snapshots.insert: r.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_links l WHERE l.link_id=r.link_id AND l.seeker_person_id=r.seeker_person_id AND l.coach_person_id=r.coach_person_id AND l.seeker_issuer=$1 AND l.seeker_subject=$2)
cc_snapshots.update: r.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_links l WHERE l.link_id=r.link_id AND l.seeker_person_id=r.seeker_person_id AND l.coach_person_id=r.coach_person_id AND l.seeker_issuer=$1 AND l.seeker_subject=$2)
cc_snapshots.delete: r.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_links l WHERE l.link_id=r.link_id AND l.seeker_person_id=r.seeker_person_id AND l.coach_person_id=r.coach_person_id AND l.seeker_issuer=$1 AND l.seeker_subject=$2)

cc_link_drops.read: (r.coach_issuer=$1 AND r.coach_subject=$2 AND r.coach_person_id=$3->>'person_id') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_links l WHERE l.link_id=r.link_id AND l.seeker_issuer=$1 AND l.seeker_subject=$2 AND l.seeker_person_id=$3->>'person_id')
cc_link_drops.insert: r.coach_issuer=$1 AND r.coach_subject=$2 AND r.coach_person_id=$3->>'person_id' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cc_links l WHERE l.link_id=r.link_id AND l.coach_person_id=r.coach_person_id AND l.coach_issuer=r.coach_issuer AND l.coach_subject=r.coach_subject)
